_comment: Transcribed from in-game screenshots taken 2026-08-04 (Steam capture 20260804154459 (art), 154734-154741 (loadout)). The page leads with the in-game class name, which is the title the loadout screen shows; the model designation rides underneath. One page covers both faction variants; both models were captured, NATO on 2026-08-04 15:43-15:48 and Pax Armata at 16:59-17:00. TBD is deliberate everywhere: a slot screen names every option in its row but describes only the highlighted one, so most options are named and not yet described.
name: Patrol Boat

options.name: Heavy Rotary MG
options.description: A heavy rotary machine gun ideal for combatting unarmored vehicles and infantry at long range.

options.name: Autocannon
options.description: Flexibly mounted 30mm chain gun effective against personnel and light vehicles.

options.name: Aim-Guided
options.description: Beam-riding anti-air missile that pilots itself once manually guided to the target. Immune to flares during manual guidance, but vulnerable to countermeasures afterwards.
options.title: Aim-Guided Missile

options.name: Coaxial LMG
options.title: Coaxial Light Machine Gun
options.description: A machine gun ideal for combatting infantry at medium-range. Less effective against lightly armored vehicles.

options.name: Lock-Guided
options.description: A surface-to-air missile designed to enage fast moving aircraft. Requires lock-on before launch, after which missiles will self-guide to the target unless intercepted by countermeasures. Designated targets can be locked on at greater range and lose below-radar protection.
options.title: Lock-Guided AA Missile

options.name: Naval Mine
options.description: Waterborne mine that detonates on contact with watercraft.

options.name: Sea Spear 74
options.description: Stern launched wire-guided torpedo capable of very high damage to enemy watercraft.

options.name: HE Guided
options.description: Precision guided shell that can lock on to targets marked with the Laser Designator or Tracer Dart.
options.title: HE Guided Shell

options.name: IR Smoke
options.description: Shell that deploys a smoke cloud to obscure vision.
options.title: IR Smoke Shell

options.name: Airburst
options.description: Smart shell that airbursts when near aircraft, boats, or the ground.
options.title: Airburst Shell

options.name: Illumination
options.title: Illumination Shell
options.description: Shell loaded with a parachute flare to mark enemies below.

_variant_note: Both factions field the same model here; only the livery differs, so the two captures show one vehicle in NATO and Pax Armata colors.
